name: Blood of Innocents
summary: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks blood for a plan against the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. The Royal Apothecary Society uses dark ingredients gathered from local bandits to pacify the encroaching company.

sections.title: A Chemical Solution
sections.body: The Horde faces a steady struggle in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company ravages the wilderness and its people. Apothecary Lydon proposes an alchemical remedy instead of sending armies to blunt their axes. He plans to brew an agent that paralyzes and pacifies the mercenaries, leaving them weak and docile.

sections.title: Stolen from the Wicked
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon needs a rare and troubling ingredient: the blood of innocents. He avoids sending Horde agents to kill innocents himself and instead turns to the crimes of the Syndicate. Fallen nobles and cutthroats occupy Durnholde Keep, where rogue shadow mages harvest innocent blood for profane rituals. Lydon makes those mages his target for alchemical supplies.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need innocent blood?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon needs innocent blood as a key ingredient in an experimental brew. He hopes to make a toxin that drains the Venture Company's violent drive in Stonetalon Mountains, leaving its members subdued and easier to handle.

faq.q: Who has the vials of innocent blood?
aliases: where to get blood of innocents
faq.answer: Syndicate shadow mages carry the vials of innocent blood. They lurk among the ruins of Durnholde Keep, southeast of Tarren Mill, and keep the blood for their own spellwork.

faq.q: Why does a Hillsbrad quest involve the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Horde leaders in Kalimdor sought scientific aid from the Royal Apothecary Society in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Venture Company conflict is in Stonetalon, while Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill has the dark craft needed to brew a specialized remedy.

The Syndicate is made up of former human nobles from the ruined kingdom of Alterac, now brigands, assassins, and cutthroats. Hoping to reclaim their lost lands, they use extortion and dark magic, and prey on travelers in Hillsbrad and Alterac.
Durnholde Keep lies southeast of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Once a human fortress and orc internment camp, it is now half in ruins and a major stronghold for the Syndicate.

faq.q: Is the Horde committing murder to get this blood?
faq.answer: No. The Royal Apothecary Society accepts gruesome methods, but Lydon directs agents to gather blood already harvested by Syndicate shadow mages from their victims.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, efficiency comes before moral qualms. Lydon's calculated approach shows how the Royal Apothecary Society uses cold logic to solve problems for their living allies.
As a tauren, you may find the taking of innocent blood unsettling. The goal is to end the Venture Company's destruction of the wilderness in Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you see its far-reaching ties at work: Forsaken alchemy in Lordaeron helps protect Horde lands in Kalimdor.
